## What is this? This is **P**higros **S**core **L**ookup Discord bot (aka PSLDiscordBot). You can get your scores by using `/get-photo`, `/get-scores`, `/export-scores` etc. Note: Requires a TapTap cloud save, or use the bot's local score system instead. ## How to use this? First time here? Follow these steps: 1. Use `/tos`, read it and press the button to agree. You can't register before that. 2. Pick one way to register: - `/account register qrcode`: link your cloud save with a QR code. - `/account register token`: link your cloud save with a token, if you already have one and don't want to go through the login process. - `/account register local`: no cloud save? Use the local score system. 3. (Optional) Use `/set-precision` if you want to see your scores more accurately. 4. Now you can use `/get-scores` or `/get-photo`. Wanna share your stats? Run `/about-me`. 5. (Optional) Run `/set-public-visibility true` to show up on `/leaderboard` and let others view your scores with the `generate_for` option of `/get-photo` and `/song-scores`. It's off by default. Local score system: manage your own scores with `/local score` family, `/local profile`, `/local challenge` and `/local currency`, or import them with `/local import` family. Use `/account switch` family to change between local and cloud mode. There are also cool commands like `/song-info`, `/song-scores`, `/poke` etc. If you see any problem, use `/report-problem` to report it (Devs may contact you for more information). ## Command usage Please check the [github address](https://github.com/yt6983138/PSLDiscordBot/blob/master/Documentation/usage.md), I recommend reading all of it before using. ToS: https://github.com/yt6983138/PSLDiscordBot/blob/master/Documentation/TermsOfServiceV3.md
Privacy Policy: https://github.com/yt6983138/PSLDiscordBot/blob/master/Documentation/PrivacyPolicy.md
